conditional_tail.scope: Fixed descriptive gross-mid response tails, not cost-adjusted expected value; day dependence and multiplicity remain.

leadlag.definition: corr(leader return ending t, follower return ending t+lag). Positive lag denotes leader-first association.
leadlag.scope: Receive-clock previous-tick diagnostic, not physical propagation or causal proof. Asynchronous sampling, stale quotes, transport, overlapping returns and shared news can move the peak. No iid confidence bands or lag winner selection.

waterfall.scope: Long hypothetical round trip; all bps relative to initial mid. Start from gross mid movement, not entry-net primary. No funding or impact.

fixture: Seeded Gaussian leader returns and an exact toy 30ms delayed follower; invented queue, trades, future mids and volatility labels. No empirical edge or transmission estimate.
